messages.content: What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?

function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the current temperature in Moscow right now. If you need up‑to‑date weather information, you might want to check a reliable weather website or app.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?" They want current weather in Moscow in Celsius. We need to provide the current temperature. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can provide a typical answer: "I don't have real-time data." We can also mention that we can't fetch real-time weather. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time weather.
